# Open Edge AI

Open Edge AI is an MIT-licensed, local-first mobile AI project.

Project website: https://open-edge-ai-app.github.io/
Source repository: https://github.com/open-edge-ai-app/core-app
Documentation: https://open-edge-ai-app.github.io/docs/

## Documentation

- Getting started: https://open-edge-ai-app.github.io/docs/getting-started.html
- Architecture: https://open-edge-ai-app.github.io/docs/architecture.html
- Local models: https://open-edge-ai-app.github.io/docs/local-models.html
- Native bridge: https://open-edge-ai-app.github.io/docs/native-bridge.html
- Development: https://open-edge-ai-app.github.io/docs/development.html
- Community: https://open-edge-ai-app.github.io/community.html
- Releases: https://open-edge-ai-app.github.io/releases.html
- Support and security: https://open-edge-ai-app.github.io/support.html

The Android app uses React Native with Kotlin native AI modules. The iOS app is
a native SwiftUI target. Model execution, retrieval, and private context are
kept on device wherever practical. Public APIs may change before a stable release.
